slots.name: advanced chip share
slots.sentence: “Most of those chips are actually manufactured in Taiwan where one company, the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation, manufactures around 90% of the world’s most advanced chips,” says Chris Miller a professor of international history at Tufts University and author of “Chip War: The Fight for the World’s Most Critical Technology.”

slots.name: CHIPS Act enactment date
slots.sentence: The CHIPS and Science Act enacted in 2022 provides funding, investment tax credits and research authorizations to boost domestic semiconductor manufacturing.
